arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
path='/workspace/tmp/fuzz_layout.py'
lines=open(path).read().split('\n')
# find the 'for trial in range(300):' line inside main and indent everything after it
out=[]
started=False
for line in lines:
    if line.strip() == 'for trial in range(300):':
        started=True; out.append(line); continue
    if started and line.startswith('    print(\'layout fuzz done'):
        started=False; out.append(line); continue
    if started:
        out.append(('    ' + line) if line.strip() else line); continue
    out.append(line)
open(path,'w').write('\n'.join(out))
EOF
python3 /workspace/tmp/fuzz_layout.py 0 2>&1 | tail -2; python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fuzz_layout; print('import clean')"
